About.title: Experience True Value with Zufriedene Verkäufe.
About.intro: Where authenticity, trust, and elegance meet. As Germany's premier platform for verified luxury trade, we bring the best of all worlds together: a beloved brand, exceptional products, and a commitment to excellence.
About.mission: "At Zufriedene Verkäufe, we believe purchasing should feel as rewarding as ownership. As the exclusive seller on our platform, every product you see is carefully selected, professionally verified, and offered with absolute confidence."

authenticity.title: Uncompromised Authenticity
authenticity.description: Every item sold on Zufriedene Verkäufe is 100% genuine. We do not permit third-party sellers, ensuring full quality control and a consistently premium standard across our catalogue.

presentation.title: Thoughtfully Presented Products
presentation.description: Each listing features clear imagery and detailed descriptions designed to help you choose with confidence and clarity. What you see is exactly what we deliver.

payments.title: Seamless and Flexible Payments
payments.description: Zufriedene Verkäufe offers secure online payment options supported by trusted financial channels. For added convenience, customers may choose flexible instalment plans.

promise.title: A Promise Beyond Purchase
promise.description: From checkout to delivery and beyond, Zufriedene Verkäufe is committed to exceptional service, reliability, and customer satisfaction—because luxury is not just what you buy but how you are treated.

about.heading: Zufriedene Verkäufe is Germany's premier platform for verified luxury trade. We turn pre-owned assets into secure investments— letting customers browse, select, and own with absolute confidence.

excellence.title: Curated Excellence
excellence.description: Discover a new standard of classifieds where luxury meets transparency through our rigorous verification protocols.
excellence.directSalesDesc: Our escrow-based direct sales model ensures that funds are only released once you have inspected and approved the item in person or via certified delivery.
excellence.qualityDesc: Every professional seller on our platform undergoes a multi-stage KYC (Know Your Customer) process, including physical address verification and trade license auditing.
excellence.identityDesc: State-of-the-art encryption protecting your personal data and browsing history from third parties.
excellence.conciergeDesc: Access to our Berlin-based support team 24/7 for dispute resolution and marketplace guidance.
excellence.logisticsDesc: Global shipping partnerships with full insurance coverage for high-value premium assets.
